janus.transport.http.name: JANUS REST (HTTP/HTTPS) transport plugin
janus.transport.http.author: Meetecho s.r.l.
janus.transport.http.description: This transport plugin adds REST (HTTP/HTTPS) support to the Janus API via libmicrohttpd.

janus.transport.websockets.name: JANUS WebSockets transport plugin
janus.transport.websockets.author: Meetecho s.r.l.
janus.transport.websockets.description: This transport plugin adds WebSockets support to the Janus API via libwebsockets.

janus.eventhandler.sampleevh.name: JANUS SampleEventHandler plugin
janus.eventhandler.sampleevh.author: Meetecho s.r.l.
janus.eventhandler.sampleevh.description: This is a trivial sample event handler plugin for Janus, which forwards events via HTTP POST.

janus.logger.jsonlog.name: JANUS JSON logger plugin
janus.logger.jsonlog.author: Meetecho s.r.l.
janus.logger.jsonlog.description: This is a trivial sample logger plugin for Janus, which saves log lines to a local JSON file.

janus.plugin.videoroom.name: JANUS VideoRoom plugin
janus.plugin.videoroom.author: Meetecho s.r.l.
janus.plugin.videoroom.description: This is a plugin implementing a videoconferencing SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) for Janus, that is an audio/video router.
